name: paul-skills:ask-matt
description: Ask which skill or flow fits your situation. A router over the skills in this repo.

interface.shortDescription: Find the right skill or workflow

name: paul-skills:better-accessibility
description: Reviews and fixes keyboard and focus behavior, ARIA, accessible names, forms, screen-reader announcements, motion and zoom in your project against WCAG 2.2.

interface.shortDescription: Focus, keyboard, ARIA, forms and screen readers

name: paul-skills:better-colors
description: Helps you build and check a color system for your project. It generates palettes, names semantic tokens, converts between formats and measures contrast.

interface.shortDescription: Building, naming and applying color systems

name: paul-skills:better-interface
description: Reviews screens and flows across accessibility, layout, writing, typography, color and UI polish. Routes change-review requests to an explicit interface-review invocation; consolidates its authorized handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Cross-discipline interface review

name: paul-skills:better-layout
description: Helps with grouping, alignment, reading order, responsive structure and room for translated text, so a layout holds up when it is resized, translated or mirrored.

interface.shortDescription: Structure, grouping, alignment and adaptive layout

name: paul-skills:better-typography
description: Sets and reviews how text renders in your product, from the type scale and spacing to font features, wrapping, truncation and punctuation.

interface.shortDescription: Fonts, type scales, spacing and wrapping

name: paul-skills:better-ui
description: Polishes the surfaces, icons and motion in your project with exact values for border radius, optical alignment, shadows, icon states and animation.

interface.shortDescription: Design engineering details for polished interfaces

name: paul-skills:better-writing
description: Writes and reviews your interface copy, from labels and errors to empty states and confirmations, so it matches your product's voice and tells people what to do next.

interface.shortDescription: UX writing, interface copy and microcopy

name: paul-skills:code-review
description: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes: Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards?) and Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/spec asked for?). Runs both reviews in parallel sub-agents and reports them side by side. Use when the user wants to review a branch, a PR, work-in-progress changes, or asks to "review since X".

interface.shortDescription: Review a diff on standards and spec

name: paul-skills:codebase-design
description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.

interface.shortDescription: Vocabulary for deep-module design

name: paul-skills:design-browser
description: Collect browser evidence for interface work. Use for reference browsing, rendered inspection, interaction QA, performance measurements or design comparison. Default to Playwright CLI; use Aside for research and general browsing.

interface.shortDescription: Route browser work and collect UI evidence

name: paul-skills:diagnosing-bugs
description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose hard bugs and regressions

name: paul-skills:domain-modeling
description: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when discussing codebase terminology, writing or editing a GLOSSARY.md, or recording or editing an ADR.

interface.shortDescription: Build and sharpen a domain model

name: paul-skills:grill-me
description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.

interface.shortDescription: Sharpen a plan through interview

name: paul-skills:grill-with-docs
description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

interface.shortDescription: Grill a design and write its docs

name: paul-skills:grilling
description: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.

interface.shortDescription: Stress-test thinking a round of questions at a time

name: paul-skills:handoff
description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

interface.shortDescription: Compact a conversation into a handoff

name: paul-skills:implement
description: Implement a piece of work based on a spec or set of tickets.

interface.shortDescription: Build work from a spec or tickets

name: paul-skills:implement-spec
description: Implement the result of /to-spec and /to-tickets in code.

interface.shortDescription: Implement the result of /to-spec and /to-tickets in code.

name: paul-skills:improve-codebase-architecture
description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

interface.shortDescription: Find and grill architecture improvements

name: paul-skills:interface-review
description: Reviews a branch, pull request or uncommitted change for the interface problems it introduced or regressed, across accessibility, layout, writing, typography, color and UI.

interface.shortDescription: Branch, PR and working-tree interface review

name: paul-skills:pr
description: Use when writing a PR body.

interface.shortDescription: Write a PR body that's fast to review

name: paul-skills:prototype
description: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question. Use when the user wants to sanity-check whether a state model or logic feels right, or explore what a UI should look like.

interface.shortDescription: Prototype to answer a design question

name: paul-skills:research
description: Investigate a question against primary sources and save cited Markdown findings. Use for local source investigation, docs or API facts, or web research through the Aside CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Research primary sources, using Aside for the web

name: paul-skills:retro
description: Conduct a retrospective on a coding session.

interface.shortDescription: Conduct a retrospective on a coding session.

name: paul-skills:setup-matt-pocock-skills
description: Configure this repo for the engineering skills: set up its issue tracker, triage label vocabulary, and domain doc layout. Run once before first use of the other engineering skills.

interface.shortDescription: Configure a repo for the skills

name: paul-skills:tdd
description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

interface.shortDescription: Test-driven red-green-refactor

name: paul-skills:teach
description: Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Learn a concept in a guided workspace

name: paul-skills:to-questionnaire
description: Turn a decision you can't fully answer into a questionnaire for someone else to fill in.

interface.shortDescription: Front-load questions into a doc for someone to answer

name: paul-skills:to-spec
description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker: no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a conversation into a spec

name: paul-skills:to-tickets
description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker (edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker).

interface.shortDescription: Split a plan into tracer-bullet tickets

name: paul-skills:triage
description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles, categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

interface.shortDescription: Move issues through triage roles

name: paul-skills:wait-what
description: Stop. That last message did not land: re-pitch it.

interface.shortDescription: Re-pitch that: simpler, with the context I'm missing

name: paul-skills:wayfinder
description: Plan a huge chunk of work (more than one agent session can hold) as a shared map of decision tickets on your issue tracker, and resolve them one at a time until the way to the destination is clear.

interface.shortDescription: Map a large effort as decision tickets

name: paul-skills:wizard
description: Generate an interactive bash wizard that walks a human through steps only they can perform. Use when provisioning infrastructure, setting up credentials or CI secrets, walking an unfamiliar third-party dashboard, or running a one-off migration or cutover. Don't invoke this for steps the agent can perform itself.

interface.shortDescription: Generate an interactive setup wizard

name: paul-skills:writing-for-agents
description: Writing documents for agents. Use when creating or editing skills, or modifying AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.

interface.shortDescription: Write documents agents consume
